newsitem.title: ITALY: Madagascar under threat from locust plague - UN.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar under threat from locust plague - UN.

text.p: Madagascar has been hit by a locust storm which is threatening to sweep over the whole country, the U.N.'s Food and Agricultural Organisation (FAO) said on Tuesday.

The Rome-based body said in a statement that a migratory locust outbreak was poised to surge across two million hectares of agricultural land in the southwest of the Indian Ocean island and was likely to spread to other parts of the country.
"There is a high risk that further breeding will occur over an increasingly large area," FAO said, adding that any spread of the locust pest would put the country's food supply in danger.
The statement called for immediate emergency aid totalling $2 million to stop the locust pest turning into a full-scale plague.
"International assistance is specifically needed for the procurement of necessary pesticides, aircraft hire, equipment...and the operational expenses of ground teams," FAO said.
